response.sql: WITH valid_trans AS (SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.balance, t.type, a.district_id, d.A3 as region FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id), account_stats AS (SELECT account_id, region, AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_amount, AVG(balance) as avg_balance FROM valid_trans GROUP BY account_id, region), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) as region_avg_amount, AVG(avg_balance) as region_avg_balance FROM account_stats GROUP BY region), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as global_avg_amount FROM region_stats) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg_amount, r.region_avg_balance, r.region_avg_amount / g.global_avg_amount as amount_ratio FROM region_stats r CROSS JOIN global_mean g WHERE g.global_avg_amount IS NOT NULL
